config.hypothesis: Fold-local selection by held-out permutation F1 importance improves positive-class nested F1 with 100 or 60 inputs; column sampling retains the Phase 14 fraction.

missing_values.method: Codebook non-responses become NaN; every tree split evaluates both missing-value directions.

nested_threshold_evaluation.protocol: Every inner and outer training fits its own selector on an internal held-out subset; thresholds use inner OOF only.

outcome.runtime_note: Includes all nine selectors, shared between the two candidate dimensions. Do not sum this runtime across candidates.
